drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A dry, percussive electric guitar plays a syncopated, muted rhythmic riff using a wah-wah pedal. The bass guitar follows a repetitive, groovy sixteenth-note pattern that locks with the kick drum. The drum kit features a tight, high-tuned snare and a crisp hi-hat playing eighth-note subdivisions with occasional open accents. A clean electric guitar enters with staccato chord stabs on the off-beats. The arrangement is minimalist and loop-based, focusing on rhythmic interplay and a steady groove. 110 BPM, E minor, 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[muted wah-wah electric guitar riff]
[tight drum kit enters with eighth-note hi-hats]

[Main Section]
[syncopated electric bass enters]
[staccato clean electric guitar chord stabs on off-beats]
[wah-wah guitar continues rhythmic pattern]

[Breakdown]
[bass and clean guitar stabs drop out]
[wah-wah guitar and drums continue]

[Outro]
[full groove returns]
[fade out on wah-wah guitar riff]

vocals.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, saturated kick drum with a long sub-tail, a metallic percussion loop, and a rhythmic, filtered synth sequence. A high-pitched, resonant synth lead enters with a repetitive, staccato pattern. The arrangement uses aggressive sidechain compression and industrial noise textures. Tempo is 130 BPM in the key of D minor.
